plan.major: Current Issues in Farm Business Management
plan.notes: Source: Alexandria Technical & Community College 2025-2026 Catalog (official PDF, updated August 25, 2025), 'Current Issues in Farm Business Management' Certificate, Total Credits: 30 / PROGRAM CREDITS: 30. Hand-transcribed 2026-10-01. The catalog publishes no term-by-term split for this certificate; courses are recorded as a single requirements block as published. Each course title is printed 'Current Issues in Farm Bus Mgmt (1-5 crs)' and is listed at 5 credits. Electives listed in the catalog (not in the 30-credit core): Current Issues in Farm Bus Mgmt FBMA2213 5, FBMA2214 5; Directed Studies-Current Issues in FBM FBMA2223 5, FBMA2224 5.
